note: true division `/` becomes floor division `//`, so the ratio truncates to 0 before the multiplication ever applies. Python has no cast to move, so the mechanism surfaces as an operator swap rather than as a misplaced cast - same family as java-ratio-trunc, different syntax. Verified: 33.33 -> 0.00
